Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，喝奶茶吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, would you like some bubble tea?

Content.SourceString: 咦？为什么你会突然想到喝奶茶？
Content.LocalizedString: Huh? Why did you suddenly think of bubble tea?

Content.SourceString: 其实不是我要喝，是浔。
Content.LocalizedString: Actually, it is not for me. It is for Hotori.

Content.SourceString: 她让我帮她买奶茶，给了两杯的钱，让我自己也点一杯。
Content.LocalizedString: She asked me to buy bubble tea for her. She gave me money for two cups and told me to order one for myself as well.

Content.SourceString: 但我对奶茶不太感兴趣，所以来问问你。
Content.LocalizedString: But I am not particularly interested in bubble tea, so I came to ask you.

Content.SourceString: 倒是可以……那我现在来找你？
Content.LocalizedString: I suppose I could… Should I come find you now?

Content.SourceString: 嗯。伊波恩附近那家奶茶店见。
Content.LocalizedString: Right. Meet at the bubble tea shop near Eibon.

Content.SourceString: 嗯。伊波恩附近那家奶茶店见。
Content.LocalizedString: Right. Meet at the bubble tea shop near Eibon.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，或许你有没有见过一种花？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, have you perhaps seen a certain type of flower?

Content.SourceString: 长得像铃兰，但是比一般的铃兰花要大。
Content.LocalizedString: It looks like lily of the valley, but larger than ordinary lily of the valley flowers.

Content.SourceString: 有多大？
Content.LocalizedString: How big?

Content.SourceString: 大概，一两个拳头那么大？
Content.LocalizedString: About… the size of one or two fists?

Content.SourceString: 没见过……或许可以去花店找找？
Content.LocalizedString: Never seen one… Maybe we could try looking at flower shops?

Content.SourceString: 我也一起去吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll come along too.

Content.SourceString: 好，麻烦鉴定师了。
Content.LocalizedString: Alright. Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 不过最近安排有些满，等傍晚的时候再过去，可以吗？
Content.LocalizedString: However, my schedule is rather full at the moment. Would it be acceptable to go in the evening instead?

Content.SourceString: 好。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay.

Content.SourceString: 好。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 我在。怎么啦？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm here. What's up?

Content.SourceString: 想请你帮我鉴定一个东西。
Content.LocalizedString: I need you to appraise something for me.

Content.SourceString: 我其实只是相较擅长找奇点，真要鉴定什么东西的话……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm actually just better at finding the Nexus of anomalies. When it comes to actually appraising things…

Content.SourceString: 我其实只是相较擅长找奇点， 真要鉴定什么东西的话……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm actually just better at finding the Nexus of anomalies. When it comes to actually appraising things…

Content.SourceString: 不过既然是你来找我，当然是乐意至极！
Content.LocalizedString: But since you've come to me, I'd be absolutely delighted to help!

Content.SourceString: 苦恼.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: troubled.jpg

Content.SourceString: 加油.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: youcandoit.jpg

Content.SourceString: 不过你都来找我了，我一定全力以赴！
Content.LocalizedString: But since you've come to me, I'll definitely give it my all!

Content.SourceString: 需要鉴定什么？是要拍张照给我吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you need appraised? Should you send me a photo of it?

Content.SourceString: 不用拍照。
Content.LocalizedString: No need for photos.

Content.SourceString: 你记得，我们今天见过面的吧。
Content.LocalizedString: You remember that we met today, correct?

Content.SourceString: 没错，见过的。
Content.LocalizedString: That's right, we did meet.

Content.SourceString: 有吗？没有吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Did we? No, I don't think we did.

Content.SourceString: 噢我想起来了！我们见过的！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, I remember now! We did meet!

Content.SourceString: 嗯。见面的时候，觉得我有什么变化吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Yes. When we met, did you notice anything different about me?

Content.SourceString: 刘海……向上偏移了2公分？
Content.LocalizedString: Your bangs… they've moved up about 2 centimeters?

Content.SourceString: 见到我的时候，右嘴角好像上翘了一点点？
Content.LocalizedString: When I saw you, was the right corner of your mouth turned up slightly?

Content.SourceString: 衬衫有一点……噢好像没有。
Content.LocalizedString: Your shirt seemed a bit… Oh, I guess not.

Content.SourceString: 衬衫没掖好的是你吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I think it's you that didn't tuck your shirt.

Content.SourceString: 不好意思.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: sorry.jpg

Content.SourceString: 今天出门有点着急，见谅见谅~
Content.LocalizedString: I was in a bit of a rush this morning. Sorry about that.

Content.SourceString: 看来你也没有发现吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So you did not notice either?

Content.SourceString: 疑惑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 想让你鉴定的是……我的眼罩。
Content.LocalizedString: What I want you to examine is… my eye patch.

Content.SourceString: 眼罩？？你戴了……眼罩吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Eye patch? You're wearing an eye patch…?

Content.SourceString: 思索.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: thinking.jpg

Content.SourceString: 哭.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: crying.jpg

Content.SourceString: 啊说起来我是有看到头发下露出的布料一角——
Content.LocalizedString: Ah, come to think of it, I did notice a bit of fabric peeking out from under your hair—

Content.SourceString: 原来是眼罩啊！嗯嗯，非常好看呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, so it is an eye patch! Yes, yes, it looks really good on you!

Content.SourceString: 我就知道，鉴定师一定会看出来的。
Content.LocalizedString: I knew it. The Appraiser would certainly notice.

Content.SourceString: 微笑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: smile.jpg

Content.SourceString: 材质和暗纹很不错吧？
Content.LocalizedString: The material and pattern are quite impressive, are they not?

Content.SourceString: 材质看起来非常细腻呢，有一点泛着光泽的感觉！
Content.LocalizedString: The texture looks incredibly delicate, with a subtle lustrous sheen to it!

Content.SourceString: 虽然只有短短一瞥，但也能窥见一二！
Content.LocalizedString: Though I only caught a glimpse, I can still appreciate the details!

Content.SourceString: 暗纹的线条很漂亮呢，游走在布料上栩栩如生的！
Content.LocalizedString: The pattern lines are beautiful, flowing so vividly across the fabric!

Content.SourceString: 嗯。是真丝材质，加上花卉暗纹，能很好地增强透气性和遮光性。
Content.LocalizedString: Indeed. It is made of real silk with floral patterns, which greatly enhances both breathability and light-blocking properties.

Content.SourceString: 收藏中品相极佳的。
Content.LocalizedString: It is one with an excellent condition among my collection.

Content.SourceString: 原来你有收藏眼罩的习惯~
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, so you collect eye patches as a hobby.

Content.SourceString: 很有伊波恩的感觉！
Content.LocalizedString: It really has that Eibon vibe!

Content.SourceString: 嗯。偶尔心血来潮就戴一下。
Content.LocalizedString: Indeed. I wear one occasionally when the mood strikes me.

OptionText.LocalizedString: May I make a small suggestion?

Content.SourceString: 不过……也许，下次戴眼罩的话，可以把刘海夹上去！
Content.LocalizedString: But… perhaps next time you wear an eye patch, you could clip your bangs up!

Content.SourceString: 这样大家就都能发现啦。
Content.LocalizedString: That way everyone would be able to see it!

Content.SourceString: ……会有点不好意思。
Content.LocalizedString: …That would be somewhat embarrassing.

Content.SourceString: 但我会考虑这个方案的。谢谢你。
Content.LocalizedString: But I will consider this proposal. Thank you.

Content.SourceString: 打扰了，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Excuse me, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 疑惑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 请问你这里有强力胶水吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you have any strong adhesive available?

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多说上次维修把工具落在你这里了。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo mentioned he left his repair tools here during his last maintenance visit.

Content.SourceString: 唔……好像没有。塔吉多记错了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… I don't have any. Taygedo must be mistaken.

Content.SourceString: 好像有……好像又没有。
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe… maybe not? I can't remember.

Content.SourceString: 我可能得翻一翻。
Content.LocalizedString: I might need to look around a bit.

Content.SourceString: 怎么了？是塔吉多要用吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What's wrong? Is Taygedo the one who needs it?

Content.SourceString: 是我用。
Content.LocalizedString: I am the one who needs it.

Content.SourceString: 做东西。
Content.LocalizedString: I am making something.

Content.SourceString: 保镖小姐要做手工？
Content.LocalizedString: The bodyguard is doing crafts?

Content.SourceString: 期待.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: ……勉强算吧。
Content.LocalizedString: …I suppose so.

Content.SourceString: 有什么需要我帮忙的尽管说。
Content.LocalizedString: Just let me know if there's anything I can help you with.

Content.SourceString: 武艺高强的同时，还会细腻的手工活……这就是强者吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Combat skills and delicate craftsmanship… now that's what I call true strength.

Content.SourceString: 可以问问是要做什么东西吗？
Content.LocalizedString: May I ask what you're planning to make?

Content.SourceString: 相框。
Content.LocalizedString: A picture frame.

Content.SourceString: 自制相框啊……是很有心意的制品。
Content.LocalizedString: A handmade picture frame… that's quite a thoughtful creation.

Content.SourceString: 做好后要套进去的照片，一定很重要吧~
Content.LocalizedString: The photo that will go in the frame must be really special.

Content.SourceString: 嗯。很珍贵。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes. It is precious.

Content.SourceString: 是与父母的合照吗？
Content.LocalizedString: A photo with your parents?

Content.SourceString: 是与朋友的合照吗？
Content.LocalizedString: A photo with your friends?

Content.SourceString: 啊我知道了，是我们上次在影棚的大合照吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Ah, I know! It's that group photo we took at the studio last time!

Content.SourceString: 不是。
Content.LocalizedString: No.
Umm…

Content.SourceString: 不过，那张不是已经被店长挂起来了吗……？
Content.LocalizedString: But, didn't Boss already hang that photo up…?

Content.SourceString: 小时候似乎有过，但后来也没见过了。
Content.LocalizedString: I had them when I was young, but have not seen any since.

Content.SourceString: 是我们大家上次在影棚的合影。
Content.LocalizedString: It is the group photo we took at the studio last time.
Ahhh…

Content.SourceString: 伤心.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: sad.jpg

Content.SourceString: 是我们大家上次在影棚的合影。
Content.LocalizedString: It is the group photo we took at the studio last time.

Content.SourceString: 我又复印了一张小尺寸的。
Content.LocalizedString: I made another copy in smaller size.

Content.SourceString: 想自己收着。
Content.LocalizedString: I wish to keep one for myself.

Content.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔……很喜欢伊波恩呢。
Content.LocalizedString: You really care about Eibon, don't you…

Content.SourceString: 表露喜爱的方式也意外地直白~
Content.LocalizedString: Your way of showing care is also surprisingly straightforward.

Content.SourceString: 嗯。
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm.

Content.SourceString: 照片是回忆的具象化。
Content.LocalizedString: Photos are memories given physical form.

Content.SourceString: 为了不失去重要的东西……一定要好好珍藏才行。
Content.LocalizedString: To avoid losing what is precious… one must preserve it with utmost care.

Content.SourceString: 哭哭.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: crying.jpg

Content.SourceString: 我现在就去买胶水。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll go buy some glue right now.

Content.SourceString: 别说了。我这就买胶水去。
Content.LocalizedString: Say no more. I'll go get some glue right away.

Content.SourceString: 相框……我们一起做吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's make the frame together.

Content.SourceString: 一会儿做相框请务必让我打下手——！！！
Content.LocalizedString: Please let me help when you're making the frame! I insist!

Content.SourceString: 有些好奇……
Content.LocalizedString: Just curious, but…

Content.SourceString: 你还记得DSD潮玩店卖的「随心泥」吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Do you remember the Imaginadough they sell at DSD?

Content.SourceString: 那个被你们收拾掉的家伙？
Content.LocalizedString: That thing you all took care of?

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯。
Content.LocalizedString: Mhm, yeah.

Content.SourceString: 如果它只是一个单纯的异象道具，你会想把它捏成什么呢？
Content.LocalizedString: If it was just a simple anomaly item, what would you like to shape it into?
Umm…

Content.SourceString: 一把训练用的新刀。
Content.LocalizedString: A new blade for training purposes.

Content.SourceString: 虽然可能做不精细，但只要开了刃就没问题。
Content.LocalizedString: It need not be refined. So long as it has an edge, it will serve its purpose.

Content.SourceString: 武器吗……可是硬度方面……
Content.LocalizedString: A weapon, huh… but what about the hardness…

Content.SourceString: 或者捏一个公寓？
Content.LocalizedString: Or perhaps shape an apartment?

Content.SourceString: 震惊.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: shocked.jpg

Content.SourceString: 浔上次抱怨店里还是太小了。
Content.LocalizedString: Hotori complained last time that the store is still too small.

Content.SourceString: 让塔吉多把那堆无用小发明们放到鬼郎丸的肚子里就好啦。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo could just put all those useless little inventions inside Kiroumaru's belly!

Content.SourceString: 不过……一整个公寓的工程量还是太大了。
Content.LocalizedString: However… constructing an entire apartment would be far too laborious.

Content.SourceString: 或许可以捏个微型的给塔吉多住。
Content.LocalizedString: Perhaps I could mold a miniature one for Taygedo to reside in.

Content.SourceString: 好，新型海獭型仓鼠。
Content.LocalizedString: Right, a new otter-shaped hamster.

Content.SourceString: 或者，可以捏些方斯？
Content.LocalizedString: Or perhaps, I could shape some Fons?

Content.SourceString: 和异象相关的犯罪事宜好像得交给管理局。
Content.LocalizedString: I believe crimes related to anomalies should be reported to the Bureau.

Content.SourceString: 嘘！危险发言，快快撤回。
Content.LocalizedString: Shh! That's dangerous talk. Take it back, quick!

Content.SourceString: 疑惑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 不要做这么危险的事啊达芙蒂尔！
Content.LocalizedString: Don't do something so dangerous, Daffodill!

Content.SourceString: 疑惑.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 虽然叫「随心泥」，但其实局限性很大。
Content.LocalizedString: Although it is called Imaginadough, it actually has many limitations.

Content.SourceString: 有没有什么外形简易又不危险的东西可以捏呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Is there anything with a simple appearance that isn't dangerous I could mold?

Content.SourceString: ……轻薄的容器。
Content.LocalizedString: …A lightweight container.

Content.SourceString: 比如，捏一个浔的酒瓶。
Content.LocalizedString: For instance, I could shape a wine bottle for Hotori.

Content.SourceString: 酒瓶里藏一个可以加热的蒸馏装置。
Content.LocalizedString: Inside the wine bottle, I could conceal a heating distillation device.

Content.SourceString: 浔把酒倒进去—装置加热—浔把酒倒出来。
Content.LocalizedString: Hotori pours wine in, the device heats it, Hotori pours wine out…

Content.SourceString: ……什么？然后呢？发生了什么？
Content.LocalizedString: …What? And then? What happens?

Content.SourceString: 等等……难道是……
Content.LocalizedString: Wait… Don't tell me it's…

Content.SourceString: 水和乙醇分离。浔的酒会变成水。
Content.LocalizedString: The water and ethanol separate. Wine gets turned into water.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Master, I want to learn this!

Content.SourceString: 好合理又好不合理，好科学又好不科学。
Content.LocalizedString: It's somehow both perfectly logical and completely absurd, scientifically sound yet totally unscientific.

Content.SourceString: 是想让店长少喝点吧……没想到还有这招。
Content.LocalizedString: You're trying to get Boss to drink less… I never would have thought of such a trick.

Content.SourceString: 是想让店长少喝点吧……没想到还有这招。
Content.LocalizedString: You're trying to get Boss to drink less… I never would have thought of such a trick.

Content.SourceString: 但是，有一个问题。
Content.LocalizedString: But there's one problem.

Content.SourceString: 什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What?

Content.SourceString: 虽然畅想了这么多……但其实「随心泥」捏出来的东西都只是橡皮泥的硬度。
Content.LocalizedString: Despite all these elaborate ideas… the truth is that anything molded from Imaginadough only has the hardness of modeling clay.

Content.SourceString: 只能看，不能用。
Content.LocalizedString: It can only be looked at, not used.

Content.SourceString: 哭哭.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: crying.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，有件事想与你详谈。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I have something I'd like to discuss with you in depth.

Content.SourceString: 不出意外的话，残虹的异能应该对你的生活造成了一些影响。
Content.LocalizedString: Zankou's Esper Ability has most likely affected your daily life in some way.

Content.SourceString: 我有时会看到残虹的幻影……难道达芙蒂尔也有过这种经历吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I sometimes see Zankou's illusion… Have you experienced something similar, Daffodill?

Content.SourceString: 她的异能会造成什么影响？
Content.LocalizedString: What effects does her Esper Ability have?

Content.SourceString: 是的。从与她搭档时开始，就一直如此。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes. Ever since I teamed up with her, it's been happening.

Content.SourceString: 与她对视过太久，或者多次进入她的幻境的人，会出现幻听幻视的情况。
Content.LocalizedString: People who gaze into her eyes for too long, or who enter her illusion too many times, can start experiencing auditory and visual hallucinations.

Content.SourceString: 比如，我就经常能看到她的幻影。
Content.LocalizedString: For example, I often see her shadows.

Content.SourceString: 好在我的眼睛能够辨认真伪。加上多年的经历，也早已习惯了无视它们的存在。
Content.LocalizedString: Fortunately, I'm good at differentiating reality from illusions. After so many years, I can basically ignore them.

Content.SourceString: 想想还挺瘆人的……
Content.LocalizedString: Now that I think about it, that's kind of creepy…

Content.SourceString: 比起这个，还有一些更麻烦的情况。如果放任不管，我担心会伤害到你。
Content.LocalizedString: That's not all. It has the potential to be far more dangerous if left unchecked. I'm worried about your safety.

Content.SourceString: 说来话长，如果鉴定师有时间，我们可以当面详谈。
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, It's a long story. If you have time, Appraiser, we can talk it over in person.

Content.SourceString: 好的，我马上来。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay, I'll be right there.

Content.SourceString: 确实值得谈谈，我稍晚抵达。
Content.LocalizedString: It's worth a discussion—I'll be there later.

Content.SourceString: 好的，我马上来。
Content.LocalizedString: Okay, I'll be right there.
